newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks slip to session lows, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks slip to session lows, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: Wall Street stocks pressed lower in late afternoon activity Thursday, triggering program trading curbs on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Dow industrials fell 50 points to 7307, leading the NYSE to impose index-arbitrage curbs at 1305 EDT/1705 GMT.
Top name tech stocks, which had provided much of the market's recent strength, continued their session-long drag on the market.
International Business Machines Corp posted the steepest decline among Dow components, falling 2-3/8 to 87-3/4. Hewlett-Packard Co fell one to 52-1/8.

The downturn proved short-lived, however, and just moments after its brief decline, the Dow recovered to about 7323, off 35 points for the day, and roughly in the middle of an extremely narrow range it had held for most of the afternoon.
